scientific.integrity: The two cutoff formulas are derived directly from the published dual-averaging recurrences under a constant subgradient. Exact rational square-root enclosures certify the finite inequalities that determine the first strict increase.
limitations: The result concerns the dual-averaging variants only.
The objective is one-dimensional and convex Lipschitz.
Only the first strict growth of the distance estimate is classified.
The finding does not assert a global convergence-rate ordering.

title: Exact startup latency of dual-averaging D-Adaptation and Prodigy
